name: Electrical and Computer Engineering Summer Program
what_you_do: A four-day program. You work with circuits, power and clean energy. You learn about AI, robots and computer security. You also try electronic design and bioengineering. You meet faculty, alumni and industry pros.
grades: Students currently in 10th or 11th grade (rising juniors and seniors)
who_can_apply: Students currently enrolled in 10th or 11th grade. Not residential.
deadline_text: The page lists $400 before May 1 and $450 before June 1 and gives no final cutoff. The registration form could not be read by this check.
how_to_apply: Step 1: fill out the Program Registration Form. Step 2: pay with the Program Payment Form. Both are needed to confirm participation. The contact is listed on the page.
notes: Confirm that registration is open before you plan around it. The page also lists a free Summer Engineering Awareness Program. It lasts six or ten days.
